name: arareader
description: Standalone smart PDF reader and editor
author: Adhi Rahmadian

scripts.build: npm run build -w @arareader/pdf && npm run build -w @arareader/desktop
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n pdf,desktop -c red,magenta "npm run dev:renderer -w @arareader/pdf" "npm run dev -w @arareader/desktop"
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run notices && npm run dist:win -w @arareader/desktop
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run notices && npm run dist:mac -w @arareader/desktop
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run notices && npm run dist:linux -w @arareader/desktop
